items.zh: 多目标移动靶对局（如 Cata IC 长横移）的误差、在靶率等指标修复，数字回到可信范围
items.en: Metrics for multi-target strafing scenarios (e.g. Cata IC Long Strafes) are fixed and back in a trustworthy range

items.zh: Coach 解读更如实：这局没有典型问题时会明说，不再出现不存在的场景名或自创评级
items.en: Coach reads results honestly: says clearly when a session has no flagged issues, and no longer invents scenario names or ratings

items.zh: 修正分析报告把正常数据表述为「降级/受限制」的误导说法
items.en: Removed misleading wording that described normal data as degraded or limited

items.zh: 场景推荐不再反复出现训练用样板场景
items.en: Scenario recommendations no longer repeat dev-template scenarios

items.zh: 游戏中途调整窗口大小或切换分辨率，录制不再中断，训练数据照常保留
items.en: Resizing the game window or switching resolution mid-session no longer interrupts recording — your training data is kept

items.zh: 窗口尺寸变化过的对局，整理结果不再因画面黑边而偏移
items.en: Analysis results for sessions where the window was resized no longer drift due to letterbox bars

items.zh: 游戏数据读取被拦截时，现在会说明具体原因（如游戏以管理员运行、杀毒软件拦截）并给出解决办法
items.en: When game data can't be read, the app now explains why (e.g. KovaaK running as administrator, antivirus interference) and what to do

items.zh: Coach 出错提示更明确：额度用完、网络波动、服务繁忙分开说清楚，额度用完可一键前往充值
items.en: Coach errors are now clearer: quota exhausted, network hiccups and busy service are explained separately, with a one-click top-up when quota runs out

items.zh: 很长的对话会自动整理记忆以保证回答质量，整理期间显示进度提示
items.en: Very long conversations are compacted automatically to keep reply quality, with a visible progress note while it happens

items.zh: 会员页移除了不准确的「自动续费」描述（当前为按月一次性购买）
items.en: Removed inaccurate auto-renewal wording from the member page (purchases are one-time per month)

items.zh: 启动过程看得见了：打开应用先看到启动画面（logo+进度条），启动慢时会提示可能原因，失败时给出明确指引
items.en: Startup is now visible: a launch screen with logo and progress appears first, slow starts explain why, and failures come with clear guidance

items.zh: 修复启动失败时应用「未响应后闪退」的问题：失败不再退出，可一键导出诊断包
items.en: Fixed the app freezing and crashing on startup failure: it now stays open with a one-click diagnostics export

items.zh: 修复部分对局在画面数据缺失时整理直接失败的问题
items.en: Fixed sessions failing outright when camera frames were missing during processing

items.zh: 动作数据整理支持「结果延续」：同一局训练再次整理时，直接沿用之前已成功的结果，不再从头重算反复折腾
items.en: Session motion-data processing now carries forward: re-processing a session keeps its previously successful result instead of reworking it from scratch

items.zh: 修复部分对局「整理刚成功、再次整理又失败」的反复问题
items.en: Fixed sessions flipping from "processed" back to "failed" when processed again

items.zh: 少数处于边界的对局不再被一刀切拒绝，现在能正常出结果
items.en: A few borderline sessions that were previously rejected outright now process successfully

items.zh: 转火类训练的动作分析上线：转火过渡时长（从上一个目标被击杀到准星重新抓住下一个目标）、转火路径效率这类转火专属指标，数值来自真值遥测，不是估算
items.en: Motion analysis for target-switching scenarios: switch transition time (from one kill to re-acquiring the next target) and switch path efficiency, measured from ground-truth telemetry rather than estimation

items.zh: 修复部分训练局分析一直停在「排队中」不出结果的问题：静态打靶类场景（如 1wall 6targets small）首次分析即可正常完成，之前卡住过的分析重试即可恢复
items.en: Fixed analyses getting stuck on "queued" and never finishing: static-clicking scenarios (e.g. 1wall 6targets small) now complete on the first try, and previously stuck analyses recover on retry

items.zh: 新用户开场引导更顺：打开应用直接进入训练正题，开场不再绕弯子
items.en: Smoother first-run onboarding: the coach gets straight to training instead of circling

items.zh: 会员页面三处修复：开通卡片深浅色配色错乱、连续包月说明与按月购买方式不一致、账户卡片错位
items.en: Three membership-page fixes: plan-card colors in dark/light themes, continuous-billing wording now matches the actual monthly purchase, and the account card no longer renders misaligned

items.zh: 动作分析时间对齐修复：所有训练的动作层指标现在对齐到真实对局窗口——此前分析窗口整体偏早约 8 秒，每局的结尾会被截掉、开头混入对局前的数据
items.en: Motion-analysis time alignment fixed: all motion metrics now align to the real round window — previously the window started about 8 seconds early, cutting off the end of each round and mixing in pre-round data

items.zh: 目标轨迹切分修复：击杀数与游戏官方统计逐条一致——此前目标被误切成碎段，击杀数虚增近一半，轨迹贴合类指标随之失真
items.en: Target track segmentation fixed: kill counts now match the game's official stats line by line — previously targets were over-segmented, inflating kills by nearly half and distorting tracking metrics

items.zh: 数据质量透明：数据有瑕疵的分析会明确标注哪些指标该谨慎看，教练解读时也会如实说明（"这一段别当真"），不再让有水分的数字冒充可信读数
items.en: Data-quality transparency: analyses with imperfect data now flag which metrics deserve caution, and the coach says so plainly instead of presenting compromised numbers as reliable readings

items.zh: 场景分类修正：转火类场景（如 Tile Frenzy 180）现在按转火方式分析，给出转火节奏、路径这类它自己的读数，而不是套用跟踪场景的尺子
items.en: Scenario classification fix: switching-style scenarios (such as Tile Frenzy 180) are now analyzed as switching, with switch cadence and path readings of their own instead of tracking-style yardsticks

items.zh: 训练记录的整理进度一目了然：整理中的记录会显示具体在等什么、还排着几局，整理完成后会主动弹提醒——不用再对着「整理中」干等
items.en: Training-record processing is now visible at a glance: rows show what is still being processed and how many runs are queued, and a notification pops up when everything is ready

items.zh: 跟枪类训练的动作分析大幅提速并修复偶发失败：不再出现长时间等待后只给基于分数的简化结果，准星与目标的贴合度、误差等动作指标秒级产出，同一局重复分析的结果保持一致
items.en: Tracking-style motion analysis is dramatically faster and no longer fails intermittently: no more long waits ending in a score-only fallback - crosshair-to-target adherence and error metrics now arrive within seconds, and repeated analysis of the same run gives consistent results

items.zh: 修复部分新用户注册后一直停在登录引导、进不了主界面的问题——浏览器完成注册后返回应用时凭证不再丢失（应用未就绪会自动重试），重开应用重新选择会员档也能接回之前完成的注册
items.en: Fixed some new users getting stuck on sign-in onboarding: the one-time credential from the browser sign-in is no longer lost — it is retried automatically if the app isn't ready, and reopening the app picks the earlier sign-up back up

items.zh: 启动更稳：应用启动时页面加载失败会自动重试，不再偶发白屏；双开应用时不再出现窗口突然变空白的问题
items.en: More resilient startup: page-load failures now retry instead of leaving a rare blank screen, and launching a second copy no longer blanks the first window

items.zh: 动作层训练诊断修复：跟枪类场景（跟踪/横移目标）现在能正常生成准星与目标关系的动作诊断，不再被误判跳过；同一批训练里个别数据异常的局不再拖累其他局的动作分析
items.en: Motion-layer diagnostics fixed: tracking-style scenarios now produce crosshair-versus-target motion analysis instead of being skipped, and one faulty round no longer drags down the rest of a session

items.zh: 修复「目标较大且移动较慢」类训练场景整理不出数据的问题：上一局残留的目标不再被误当作画面残影清理掉，这类场景的数据整理与分析恢复正常
items.en: Fixed “larger + slowed” style scenarios failing to process their data: targets carried over from the previous run are no longer mistaken for on-screen debris, so these scenarios process and analyze normally again

items.zh: 新用户开通链路修复：官方「Aiming Cookie」档在 Provider 列表置顶首选；登录后客户端自动轮询推进，不再无限等待浏览器返回；试用额度到账后引导按钮自动出现，不再需要重启
items.en: New-user funnel fixes: the official Aiming Cookie option now leads the provider list; the client polls automatically after sign-in instead of waiting forever; the trial CTA appears on its own once quota lands — no restart needed

items.zh: 设备登录授权有效期从 10 分钟延长到 30 分钟，收验证码更从容
items.en: Device handoff validity extended from 10 to 30 minutes, leaving ample time for email verification

items.zh: 修复新用户选择「先免费体验」后无法完成初始设置的问题——「进入工作台」按钮不再无法点击
items.en: Fixed new trial users being unable to finish onboarding after choosing the free trial — the enter-workspace button no longer stays disabled

items.zh: 安全加固：本地模型服务接口现在要求启动级访问令牌，阻断网页对本地凭据的跨源读取
items.en: Security hardening: the local model-service API now requires a launch-scoped access token, blocking cross-origin credential reads from web pages

items.zh: 修复异常会话文件导致训练历史列表无法打开的问题
items.en: Fixed corrupted session files breaking the training history list

items.zh: 修复极端情况下启动白屏的问题——应用现在会自动识别并丢弃异常缓存
items.en: Fixed a rare startup white-screen: corrupted local cache is now detected and discarded automatically

items.zh: 修复更改存储位置时极端情况下数据看似丢失的问题
items.en: Fixed a rare case where changing the storage location could make data appear missing

items.zh: 修复遥测帧稀疏时单局分析崩溃的问题
items.en: Fixed a crash when analyzing runs with sparse telemetry frames

items.zh: 分析准备阶段的视频校验移入后台线程，分析期间界面响应更流畅
items.en: Video verification during analysis now runs off the main thread for a smoother UI

items.zh: 新增 KovaaK 安装指引卡片，界面动效与交互打磨
items.en: New KovaaK installation guide card, plus interface motion and interaction polish

items.zh: 修复部分 Windows 预览版系统下训练视频无法录制的问题
items.en: Fixed training video recording on certain Windows Insider preview builds

items.zh: 改进虚拟显示器与远程桌面环境下的录制兼容性
items.en: Improved recording compatibility on virtual displays and remote desktop setups

items.zh: 修复超长对话首次继续时全量重发导致的请求失败与消耗暴涨——现在会自动压缩历史后正常继续
items.en: Fixed very long conversations failing or burning excess quota when first resumed: history is now compacted automatically before sending

items.zh: 录制引擎自愈重启会写入诊断记录，远程排查问题更快
items.en: Self-healing restarts of the capture engine are now recorded in diagnostics for faster remote troubleshooting

items.zh: 修复新用户在连接模型服务一步被卡住的问题——现在可以先免费体验，完成一局分析验证后再订阅
items.en: Fixed new users getting stuck on the model-service step: you can now start with the free trial first and subscribe after completing one verification analysis

items.zh: 修复 Coach 偶发空回复的问题——现在会自动重试一次，不再需要手动重新提问
items.en: Coach no longer returns an occasional empty reply: it now retries automatically once, so you don't have to ask again by hand

items.zh: 所选模型失效时自动恢复可用并给出处理指引，不再卡在报错上
items.en: If the selected model becomes unavailable, the app now repairs it automatically and points you to what to do next instead of getting stuck on the error

items.zh: 网关额度类错误的提示文案更清晰，一眼能看出问题所在
items.en: Error messages for gateway quota issues are now clearer, so you can tell at a glance what went wrong

items.zh: 录屏支持非标准分辨率窗口——高分屏缩放、虚拟显示器等导致窗口宽高为奇数时自动适配，此前这类电脑完全无法录制训练视频
items.en: Screen recording now supports non-standard window sizes: odd pixel dimensions from display scaling or virtual displays are handled automatically instead of failing

items.zh: 修复采集子进程静默崩溃的问题——崩溃原因会记录进诊断包，游戏重启等临时性故障后自动恢复
items.en: Telemetry capture subprocesses no longer fail silently: crash reasons are recorded in diagnostics, and transient failures recover automatically

items.zh: 采集在异常环境（游戏退出瞬间、移动磁盘掉线等）下更稳定，不再空转刷日志
items.en: Capture is more resilient in adverse conditions such as game-exit races or removable-drive dropouts, without busy-looping

items.zh: 诊断包新增录屏窗口尺寸、编码尺寸、编码器各层失败详情与采集子进程崩溃日志，远程排查更快
items.en: Diagnostics bundles now include capture window size, encode size, per-layer encoder failure details and capture subprocess crash logs for faster remote troubleshooting

items.zh: 训练历史支持整条删除——悬停训练记录点垃圾桶两段确认即可清理不要的记录
items.en: Training history now supports deleting a record: hover a row and click the trash icon twice to remove it

items.zh: 打完一局当场就能深度分析，不用再退出 KovaaK——跟枪等场景的深度诊断数据现在按局实时进入系统
items.en: Deep analysis is now available right after each run, without quitting KovaaK first

items.zh: 修复部分多显卡/特殊显示环境下录屏建立失败的问题——现在会自动换用其他显卡重试采集
items.en: Fixed screen capture failing to start on some multi-GPU setups; capture now retries automatically on another GPU

items.zh: 修复自带 Key 直连 DeepSeek 官方端点时对话发送失败的问题
items.en: Fixed conversations failing when using your own DeepSeek API key on the official endpoint

items.zh: 兼容部分 AMD 老显卡——视频录制初始化失败时自动切换软件编码，不再整体失效
items.en: Compatibility fix for some older AMD GPUs — recording now falls back to software encoding instead of failing entirely

items.zh: 修复训练途中调整窗口大小后，之后所有对局都无法分析的问题
items.en: Fixed all later runs failing to analyze after resizing the game window mid-session

items.zh: 修复 Steam 正在更新 KovaaK 时启动本软件，导致对局记录丢失的问题
items.en: Fixed run tracking going silent when the app starts while Steam is updating KovaaK

items.zh: 自定义数据存储位置——录像与遥测可一键迁到非系统盘，C 盘不再被占满
items.en: Custom data location — move recordings and telemetry off your system drive

items.zh: 用户中心新增「调用记录」——每次 AI 调用的时间、模型与 token 用量一目了然
items.en: Usage records in Account Center — time, model and tokens for every AI call

items.zh: 长对话记忆修复——历史不丢、上下文更连贯、回复更省额度
items.en: Long-conversation memory fix — full history retained with cache-backed replies

items.zh: 修复新对话快速连发消息被拆散到多个会话的问题
items.en: Fixed rapid-fire messages in a new chat being split across sessions

items.zh: 修复连通测试误报「登录凭证已失效」的问题
items.en: Fixed connection test falsely reporting expired credentials

items.zh: 顶栏讨论条防遮挡三键
items.en: Top-bar discussion chips no longer overlap the three window buttons

items.zh: 安装与更新流程稳定性
items.en: More stable install and update flow

items.zh: 官方场景库搜索（17.5 万场景模糊匹配）
items.en: Official scenario library search (fuzzy match across 175k scenarios)
